title: Centralize launch decision ladder, rollback scenarios, and incident comms templates
creator: Maya Alvarez
description:
Purpose: Create a single coordinated artifact and operations flow that teams can use during the upcoming runtime-1.22 launch. This ticket scopes the decision ladder (go/no-go criteria and who signs off), a set of rollback scenarios with technical owners and runbook pointers, and a small library of incident communications templates for internal and external stakeholders. The goal is to reduce cognitive load during incidents, make rollback decisions faster, and ensure consistent external messaging across Eng, SRE, Support, and Marketing.

Scope:
- Define gate criteria and a decision ladder that covers infra, API compatibility, performance SLOs, and data/security blockers.
- Enumerate rollback scenarios (partial deploy rollback, model variant fallback, regional drain) with owners and minimal steps.
- Draft incident comms templates for internal on-call, leadership, customer-facing status pages, and enterprise contacts.
- Create a coordination checklist for pre-launch watch and first 72 hours of post-launch monitoring.
- Publish the artifacts in Confluence and wire them into Console runbooks + Slack on-call channels.

Out of scope: automating rollbacks or building the orchestration; those are separate engineering tickets to consume these artifacts.
acceptance_criteria: Decision ladder doc exists and is reviewed by Eng, SRE, Product, and Legal
Rollback scenarios list includes owner, trigger condition, and step-by-step minimal rollback steps for at least 3 scenarios
Comms templates for internal incident, external status update, and customer outreach are drafted and approved by Support and Marketing
Confluence page published and linked from launch checklist; Console runbook has pointer to the page
Stakeholder signoffs recorded in the ticket comments and owners assigned for first-72h watch rotations
